# Welcome Centers

# Welcome Centers  
Visit any one of our VisitPITTSBURGH Welcome Centers in the Greater Pittsburgh region.  
**The WELCOME PITTSBURGH Welcome Center at Pittsburgh International Airport is open with limited hours.**  
**To connect with a Visitor Services Representative, and request hours of operation, please call
877-LovePGH (877-568-3744) or email info@visitpittsburgh.com. You can also click the yellow chat box in the bottom of the screen to connect with our staff via LiveChat. **

# Welcome Centers
## Welcome Pittsburgh

## Welcome Pittsburgh  
### _Information Center_  
### Pittsburgh International Airport  
Landside Terminal on Baggage Claim level  
Our Welcome Center provides our guests with informative attraction and event brochures, city maps, restaurant guides, accommodations information and more to help make the most of your Pittsburgh experience.

# Welcome Centers
## Located at our Partner Attractions

## Located at our Partner Attractions  
**_All hours are subject to change, please check with our host partners for the most up to date hours of operation._**  
### Senator John Heinz History Center  
1212 Smallman St., Strip District  
### The Welcome Center at the Duquesne Incline  
Lower Station: 1197 West Carson St.
Upper Station: 1220 Grandview Ave., Mt. Washington  
### Fort Pitt Museum  
601 Commonwealth Place, Point State Park, Downtown  
### Golden Triangle Bike Rental _(Seasonal)_  
600 1st Ave., Downtown
